text: Carried from S3 (ticket 12): (1) .pane-placeholder:focused (studio-shell.css) still rings the whole pane, so a focused composite pane (e.g. source records) shows the pane ring AND the row frame; A11yTreeSuite asserts the pane ring on a plot pane. Decide here, with :focus-visible gating: composite panes should drop the pane ring, forms/plots keep it. (2) DESIGN_SPEC §15 'a composite with no items shows the ring on the container' is unimplemented (JavaFX has no :empty; needs a code pseudo-class). (3) S3 cursor rules gate on :focused; move them to focus-visible here.
